messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: R 3.3.0
parts:
As many of you know, R 3.3.0 was released yesterday.

Within a couple of hours of the Ubuntu packages becoming available on CRAN, we should have support on shinyapps.io.

Until then, if you are using 3.3.0 locally, you will experience the error "Unhandled Exception: HTTP 599: Connection closed" when deploying to shinyapps.io. Enhancing this message to be more informative is high on our list of things to do, and we appreciate your patience.

We will post a follow up when 3.3.0 is good to go.

Cheer!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: R 3.3.0
parts:
You should now be able to deploy applications targeting R 3.3.0.

My apologies for the delay in rolling this out, it turns out that the Ubuntu packages for 12.04 were no longer being built.
We have just rolled out an update to the application environment to execute in Ubuntu 14.04 which does have R 3.3.0 packages available.
You might experience slower than normal deploys as we populate the package cache against this environment.

If you experience problems, please let us know!
